# Expected fixture: fm1wifi_power_up() against core_model.txt, written by hand from docs/WIFI.md "Stage 2
# bring-up" (the steps of JieLi's wf_clk_rst_init and wdma_init: registers, bits, order, delays), not
# generated from the code. Format: tests/wifi/sdio_model.h. Values are what the model holds after each write.

# what power-down puts back: the WL30 host block, WF_CON7, WF_CON4..WF_CON0, then CLK_CON1's WiFi bits
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000000
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000008
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x00001234
rd32 0x14050 -> 0x00000000
rd32 0x1404c -> 0x00000000
rd32 0x14048 -> 0x00000000
rd32 0x14044 -> 0x00000000
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000000
clk 0x0000 -> 0xc000                # CLK_CON1 bits 15-14 cleared

# wf_clk_rst_init: WF_CON0-4 = 0
wr32 0x14040 0x00000000
wr32 0x14044 0x00000000
wr32 0x14048 0x00000000
wr32 0x1404c 0x00000000
wr32 0x14050 0x00000000
# WF_CON0 |= 0x100, |= 0x40, |= 0x1; 1 us; |= 0x4; 1 us; |= 0x8; 1 us; |= 0x2; 50 us
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000000
wr32 0x14040 0x00000100
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000100
wr32 0x14040 0x00000140
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000140
wr32 0x14040 0x00000141
delay 1
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000141
wr32 0x14040 0x00000145
delay 1
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x00000145
wr32 0x14040 0x0000014d
delay 1
rd32 0x14040 -> 0x0000014d
wr32 0x14040 0x0000014f
delay 50
# WF_CON7: bits 7-0 = 5; bits 15-8 and 23-16 cleared; bits 26-24 set; bit 30 set; bit 31 cleared
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x00001234
wr32 0x1405c 0x00001205
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x00001205
wr32 0x1405c 0x00000005
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x00000005
wr32 0x1405c 0x00000005
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x00000005
wr32 0x1405c 0x07000005
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x07000005
wr32 0x1405c 0x47000005
rd32 0x1405c -> 0x47000005
wr32 0x1405c 0x47000005

# wdma_init: WF_CON3 |= 1 << 24
rd32 0x1404c -> 0x00000000
wr32 0x1404c 0x01000000
# host 0x04: |= 0x800, 0x400, 0x200, 0x20, 0x10; &= ~0x8; |= 0x4, 0x2, 0x1
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000008
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000808
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000808
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000c08
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000c08
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e08
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e08
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e28
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e28
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e38
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e38
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e30
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e30
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e34
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e34
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e36
rd32 0x30f04 -> 0x00000e36
wr32 0x30f04 0x00000e37
# host 0x00: |= 0x400; &= ~0x200; &= ~0x100; bits 7-5 = 3; &= ~0x10; |= 0x8, 0x4, 0x2, 0x1
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000000
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000400
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000400
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000400
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000400
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000400
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000400
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000460
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000460
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000460
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000460
wr32 0x30f00 0x00000468
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x00000468
wr32 0x30f00 0x0000046c
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x0000046c
wr32 0x30f00 0x0000046e
rd32 0x30f00 -> 0x0000046e
wr32 0x30f00 0x0000046f
